turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

I’ve had a cough and nasal congestion with a clear runny nose for the past 2 weeks. I’ve also had pain related to this—intensity 6 out of 10, mainly at the top of my head, both cheeks, and my temples.

Do you have a fever, or have you had any thick yellow/green nasal discharge?
Do you have a fever, or have you had any thick yellow/green nasal discharge?
Have your symptoms been getting better, getting worse, or staying about the same over these 2 weeks?
They’ve been staying about the same over these 2 weeks.
Do you have facial pain or pressure that gets worse when you bend forward?
Yes—there’s facial pain/pressure, mainly at the top of my head, both cheeks, and my temples.
Have you had any shortness of breath, chest pain, or wheezing?
I don't know. I can say I have a cough, but I don’t know about shortness of breath, chest pain, or wheezing.
Is the cough mostly dry, or are you coughing up mucus?
Do you have itchy/watery eyes, sneezing, or a history of seasonal allergies?
Have you had any severe headache unlike usual, vision changes, swelling/redness around the eyes, confusion, or a stiff neck?

[DDX] Acute rhinosinusitis (likely viral/post-viral), Acute bacterial rhinosinusitis, Upper respiratory infection/common cold, COVID-19, Tension-type headache

Two weeks of cough, nasal congestion, clear rhinorrhea, and facial pressure over the cheeks/temples with symptoms staying about the same is most consistent with rhinosinusitis, most likely viral/post-viral. Bacterial sinusitis is possible because symptoms have lasted around 2 weeks, but the clear runny nose and lack of clear worsening, fever, or purulent discharge make it less certain.

Please seek urgent care now if you have any of these: trouble breathing, chest pain, high fever, swelling/redness around an eye, vision changes, severe worsening headache, confusion, stiff neck, or dehydration.

If you want, I can also suggest home care and when to see a clinician in person.
